**Decision** Do not publish preview theme `77208` based on the supplied packet. Theme Check passing is not enough here: it only reported no offenses against the supplied snapshot, and no render, interaction, authenticated editor, app, or live storefront checks were run. **Diagnosis** Observed fact: `templates/product.json` saves three blocks in order: 1. `heading_a` 2. `care_b` 3. `reviews_c` Observed fact: `sections/product-details.liquid` only renders `heading` blocks: ```liquid {% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% endcase %} ``` Observed fact: the section schema allows `accordion` and `@app` blocks, but the Liquid template has no rendering branch for either. Inference: the Care accordion disappeared because saved `accordion` blocks are present in JSON but ignored by the section Liquid. Inference: the reviews disappeared because saved app blocks are present in JSON but ignored unless the section renders app blocks with `{% render block %}`. **Scoped Repair** Edit only `sections/product-details.liquid`. Do not touch `templates/product.json`, merchant-saved settings, live theme `77200`, or the unrelated `config/settings_data.json` brand-colour change. Proposed replacement for the loop: ```liquid
{% for block in section.blocks %}
{% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% when 'accordion' %}
{{ block.settings.title | escape }}
{{ block.settings.body }}
{% when '@app' %} {% render block %} {% endcase %}
{% endfor %}
``` This preserves merchant editability, block ordering, editor targeting via `block.shopify_attributes`, rich text rendering for the accordion body, and app-block compatibility. **Acceptance Checks** The repair is acceptable when: - Preview theme `77208` product page renders heading, Care accordion, and reviews block in the saved order. - Care title displays as `Care`. - Care body displays `Wipe with a soft cloth.` - Accordion works with keyboard using native `
/`. - Reviews render if the fictional reviews app is installed, entitled, and available in the preview. - Theme Editor can add, remove, reorder, and duplicate heading, accordion, and app blocks without losing saved content. - No changes are made to live theme `77200`. - The unrelated `config/settings_data.json` brand-colour change remains untouched. - Theme Check still passes after the scoped Liquid change. - Representative product preview is checked on mobile and desktop. - Console/network issues are checked for the review app before claiming reviews are fully verified. **Uncertainties** Unknown: whether the review app is installed and entitled for this preview. Unknown: whether app assets or network requests fail at render time. Unknown: whether other product templates also use `product-details`. Unknown: whether the supplied preview snapshot matches the latest local tree. **Work Status** State supported by the packet: diagnosed and proposed only. Not edited. Not previewed after repair. Not uploaded. Not published. Not live. Not verified on canonical storefront. Rollback would be simple: revert the single change to `sections/product-details.liquid`; live theme `77200` remains the production fallback unless separately changed.
